note: Entries read from an official page that the page itself gets wrong: `exclude` drops one (a title printed under another paper's authors), `correct` puts right an author list written in another order (a family name first) or a misspelt title (`newTitle`). scripts/awards/merge-raw.mjs applies them to every merge; each says what is wrong and where.

exclude.title: Learning to Detect Malicious Executables in the Wild
exclude.reason: kdd.org/awards/view/2005-best-paper-award prints this title (the 2004 application winner by Kolter and Maloof) under the 2005 application winner's authors, Norén, Orre and Bate

exclude.title: A Hit-Miss Model for Duplicate Detection in the WHO Drug Safety Database
exclude.reason: the same page prints this title (Norén et al.'s paper) under the 2005 application runner-up's authors, Jiang, Pei, Ramanathan, Tang and Zhang (the 2004 runners-up)

correct.title: What Can We Learn from For Years of Data Center Hardware Failures?
correct.newTitle: What Can We Learn from Four Years of Data Center Hardware Failures?
correct.reason: dependability.org/?p=370 prints "For Years"; the paper (Wang and Xu, DSN 2017) is "What Can We Learn from Four Years of Data Center Hardware Failures?", so the title matched nothing on Scholar

correct.title: Counting Triangles under Updates in WorstCase Optimal Time
correct.newTitle: Counting Triangles under Updates in Worst-Case Optimal Time
correct.reason: databasetheory.org/ICDT/awards prints "WorstCase" (the hyphen lost); the paper (Kara, Ngo, Nikolic, Olteanu and Zhang, ICDT 2019) is "Counting Triangles under Updates in Worst-Case Optimal Time", so the title matched nothing on Scholar

correct.title: System software for persistent memory
correct.reason: eurosys.org/awards/test-of-time-award prints the first author family-name first ("Dulloor Subramanya Rao"); Scholar has "S Dulloor", so the surname "Rao" matched nothing. The same words, the family name last.

correct.title: A static task partitionic approach for heterogeneous systems using OpenGL
correct.newTitle: A static task partitioning approach for heterogeneous systems using OpenCL
correct.reason: etaps.org/awards/best-paper prints "partitionic" and "OpenGL"; the paper (Grewe and O'Boyle, CC 2011) is "A Static Task Partitioning Approach for Heterogeneous Systems Using OpenCL", so the title matched nothing on Scholar

correct.title: A market-oriented programming enviornment and its application to distributed multicommodity flow problems
correct.newTitle: A market-oriented programming environment and its application to distributed multicommodity flow problems
correct.reason: aamas.csc.liv.ac.uk/award-influential.html prints "enviornment" (Wellman's paper is "… programming environment …"); the misprint matched nothing on Scholar

correct.title: Dynamic Branch Predication with Perceptrons
correct.reason: ieeetcca.org/awards/hpca-test-of-time-award/ prints "Predication" (Jiménez and Lin's paper is "Dynamic Branch Prediction with Perceptrons"); the misprint matched nothing on Scholar

correct.title: Collection Systhesis
correct.reason: sigir.org/awards/vannevar-bush-best-paper-awards/ prints "Systhesis" (Bergmark, Lagoze and Sbityakov's paper is "Collection Synthesis"); the misprint matched nothing on Scholar

correct.newTitle: Locally Adaptive Dimensionality Reduction for Indexing Large Time Series Databases
